itinerary.title: Nusa Penida Island OR Nusa Dua Tour

activities.text: A) Nusa Penida Island — please choose 1 or 2
sub: Transfer hotel to Sanur Jetty (6.30 - 7.30am pickup)
Ferry ride to Nusa Penida Island (sharing ferry)
1) West Nusa Penida: Kelingking Beach, Broken Beach, Angel Billabong Beach, Crystal Bay Beach
2) West & East Nusa Penida: Kelingking Beach, Diamond Beach (recommended — less crowded, less walking), Crystal Bay
Waterblow (optional — unique reef with massive waves crashing)

activities: Bale Udang Lake View honeymoon dinner

itinerary.title: Kintamani - Ubud Tour
activities: Alas Harum Rice Terrace (more activity options)
Kintamani Mount Batur (magnificent view of the volcanic mountain)

expect.title: Nusa Penida West
expect.body: Highly popular & crowded locations where waiting in line for photo stops is common. Walking distance to photo spot takes about 20 minutes walk.

expect.title: Double Sharing Room
expect.body: 3-star hotel only offers double-sharing rooms as standard. If you require a triple-sharing room, extra bed will be provided.

expect.title: Accommodation
expect.body: Min. 3 consecutive night stay during 22 Dec - 4 Jan 2027. Check-out is not allowed on 31st December.

expect.title: Transportation
expect.body: 2 - 4 pax (Avanza), 5 - 6 pax (Innova), 7 - 12 pax (Hiace). Transport & Guide - 12 Hours Basis. Extra Hour 150,000 IDR/hour (must be paid in cash to driver). Only 1 baggage per person.

expect.title: Heavy Traffic in Bali
expect.body: It's common to encounter heavy traffic in Bali especially during Peak Season. Activities or tours may experience delays from the scheduled time. Traffic in Nusa Penida: due to the narrow roads, travel time between locations may take up to 2 hours.

expect.title: Arrival / Departure
expect.body: Arrival on 1st day included with Airport Transfer & Half Day Tour. No tour is included on the last day (4th day), only airport transfer is available. Please add half-day or full-day transportation with a driver-guide for additional tour.
